a tense atmosphere: After the two leaders argued loudly, there was a tense atmosphere in the meeting room for the rest of the day.
兩位領導人大聲爭吵後，會議室裡整天都瀰漫著緊張的氣氛。
a tense situation: The police officer spoke calmly to the angry crowd, trying to calm down a tense situation outside the stadium.
警察冷靜地對憤怒的群眾說話，試圖緩和體育場外緊張的局勢。
tense muscles: After sitting at his desk all day, Ken had tense muscles in his neck, so he went for a massage.
肯在書桌前坐了一整天後，脖子的肌肉緊繃，所以他去按摩了。
the past tense: When you write about what happened last weekend, remember to use the past tense, such as "went" and "saw."
當你寫上週末發生的事時，記得要用過去式，例如「went」和「saw」。
feel tense: Whenever her boss watches her work, Lily starts to feel tense, as if every muscle in her body has tightened up.
每當老闆看著她工作時，莉莉就開始感到緊張，好像全身每塊肌肉都繃緊了。
a terminal illness: After the doctor told him he had a terminal illness, Mr. Lin decided to spend his last months traveling with his family.
醫生告訴林先生他得了末期疾病後，他決定和家人一起旅行度過最後幾個月。
terminal cancer: Grandpa was diagnosed with terminal cancer, and the doctors said he probably had only six months left to live.
爺爺被診斷出癌症末期，醫生說他可能只剩六個月可活。
terminal decline: Because fewer people read printed newspapers, many experts believe the industry is now in terminal decline and cannot recover.
由於閱讀紙本報紙的人越來越少，許多專家認為這個產業正處於無可挽回的衰退，無法復甦。
the bus terminal: All the long-distance buses leave from the bus terminal next to the train station, so we bought our tickets there.
所有長途客運都從火車站旁的公車總站出發，所以我們在那裡買了票。
a computer terminal: Each student in the library can log in at a computer terminal to search for books and check their accounts.
圖書館裡每位學生都可以在電腦終端機登入，搜尋書籍並查看自己的帳戶。
a terrific opportunity: Studying abroad for a year is a terrific opportunity to learn a new language and make friends from other countries.
出國留學一年是學習新語言、結交外國朋友的絕佳的機會。
at a terrific speed: The sports car raced past us at a terrific speed, and a few seconds later it disappeared around the corner.
那輛跑車以驚人的速度從我們身旁呼嘯而過，幾秒後就消失在轉角。
a terrific amount of: Organizing the school festival took a terrific amount of time and energy, but everyone agreed it was worth it.
籌辦校慶花了大量的時間和精力，但大家都認為很值得。
feel terrific: After a good night's sleep and a healthy breakfast, I feel terrific and ready to start the new week.
睡了一夜好覺又吃了健康的早餐後，我感覺棒極了，準備好迎接新的一週。
be thankful for small mercies: Our car broke down in the rain, but at least nobody was hurt, so we should be thankful for small mercies.
我們的車在雨中拋錨了，但至少沒有人受傷，所以我們應該為小小的幸運而感恩。
be thankful that…: We should all be thankful that nobody was injured in the fire; it could have been much worse.
我們都應該慶幸沒有人在火災中受傷；情況原本可能糟糕得多。
thankful to be alive: After the terrible car crash, the driver said he was simply thankful to be alive and would drive more carefully.
在那場可怕的車禍後，駕駛說他只是慶幸還活著，以後會更小心開車。
theoretical physics: Stephen Hawking was famous for his work in theoretical physics, especially his ideas about black holes and time.
史蒂芬・霍金以他在理論物理方面的研究聞名，尤其是他對黑洞與時間的見解。
a theoretical possibility: Life on that distant planet is a theoretical possibility, but scientists have not found any real evidence yet.
那顆遙遠的行星上有生命是理論上的可能，但科學家還沒有找到任何真正的證據。
in theoretical terms: In theoretical terms, the plan should work, but in practice it may be too expensive and difficult.
從理論上說，這個計畫應該行得通，但實際上可能太昂貴又太困難。
a theoretical framework: Before collecting data, the researchers built a theoretical framework to explain how stress affects students' sleep.
在蒐集資料之前，研究人員建立了一個理論架構，來解釋壓力如何影響學生的睡眠。
a thorough investigation: The police promised a thorough investigation into the fire to find out exactly how it started.
警方承諾對這場火災進行徹底的調查，查明起火的確切原因。
a thorough understanding: To pass the final exam, you need a thorough understanding of every chapter, not just the main ideas.
要通過期末考，你需要對每一章都有透徹的理解，而不只是了解大意。
a thorough check: Before the long trip, the mechanic gave our car a thorough check, looking at the brakes, tires, and engine.
長途旅行前，技師幫我們的車做了全面的檢查，查看了煞車、輪胎和引擎。
be thorough in one's work: A good editor must be thorough in his work, checking every sentence carefully so that no mistakes are missed.
好的編輯必須工作仔細周全，仔細檢查每個句子，不漏掉任何錯誤。
a thoughtful gift: Amy gave her mom a thoughtful gift: a photo album she made by hand with pictures of their family trips.
艾咪送給媽媽一份用心的禮物：一本她親手做、放滿家庭旅遊照片的相簿。
a thoughtful look: When I asked him about his future plans, he gave me a thoughtful look and said nothing for a while.
當我問他未來的計畫時，他露出沉思的表情，好一陣子都沒說話。
a thoughtful analysis: After weeks of careful thinking, the professor wrote a thoughtful analysis that considered every side of the issue.
經過數週的仔細思考，教授寫了一篇深思熟慮的分析，考慮到這個議題的每個面向。
It was thoughtful of you to: It was thoughtful of you to bring me soup when I was sick; it really made me feel better.
你真貼心，在我生病時帶湯給我；這真的讓我感覺好多了。
